display.mission_label: 滑坡/泥石流灾后搜索与人员转运

assumptions: Shared camera allocation/contact policy (authored, uncalibrated; not catalog urgency): all scenes use T002=70, T014=70 (80 for locally believed major/destroyed damage), and established-human T027=78. A single-frame camera-candidate T027 stays <=64; person/human detections of the same locally associated candidate in >=2 distinct capture parent /image IDs from the same reporting agent promote its T027 to 81, above those surveys at a safe boundary. Raw/associated copies, duplicate boxes and replays of the same capture count once. An existing waiting proposed T027 is refreshed in-place once on promotion, without a new A050 or revision; timestamps and frame IDs are not proposal-signature changes. Camera-review T011 stays <=63. Failed candidate A009 sensor contacts suppress the same candidate or a locally recorded site within 3 m for 120 s and require camera presence evidence acquired after the failure before retry; failure does not establish human absence. These are shared defaults even without camera_search_policy; explicit existing overrides are honored, and regional search policies are unchanged. Existing commitments use authored policy fields F202/F209/F212 from 10_字段385; 05_任务96 and 14_场景任务映射 do not mandate task ordering. A coordinator-known accepted/executing commitment with a matching delivered current-task id/revision remains an allocator candidate, subject to priority, interruptibility, capability, access, payload and energy checks. Queued A052 and assignments awaiting delivery/acceptance remain reserved; unmatched current-task reports do not release them. A053 acceptance-to-deadline windows are not unconditional uninterruptible leases: replacement acceptance still waits for the real action boundary and A056 checkpoint, with A057 revalidation on resume. Equal-priority 81 contacts cannot interrupt each other. A queued camera T027 is canceled as stale through A054 only when its exact local candidate has a delivered belief.entity_ref and the referenced human needs are known without a contact need. Recheck before allocation/acceptance and before initial approach/A009, not after this task own successful contact; no distance-only identity or suppression of unassociated tracks. A059 services may preempt only a lower-priority executing preemptible ordinary commitment through the existing A053/A056 action-boundary checkpoint and A057 resume; active service scopes and real capability/access/energy/aboard constraints remain binding. Service A053 rechecks local commitments, and refusals retain busy/payload/access/energy/tool causes instead of all becoming capability failures. Fresh unassociated tracks can still starve lower-priority searches under this unchanged policy. No scene switch, truth, count, location, outcome or capability change is introduced. Survey-relative starvation is expected to be removed only when corroboration and real capability, access, energy and delivery permit; contact, rescue and fixed-horizon results are not guaranteed.

Camera re-sightings of an already contacted person (a local non-camera human with delivered contact needs) associate to that person when strict point-in-box and camera-track matches miss, using the same measured box tests: its contact foot point projected inside the box, else within the measured bottom-edge half-span around the box bottom-centre ground estimate. One-person-per-frame exclusion still applies. This prevents repeat contacts of the same known resident from minting new tracks; it never marks an uncontacted or unknown person absent and changes no truth, needs, urgency or capability.

A carrier with an unacknowledged person aboard does not accept (A053) or resume (A057) unrelated work such as contact, survey or clearance until that person is handed over; care, load, transport, handover and water-recovery tasks (T029-T036) still proceed. This applies the existing A059 service rule ("a team with a person aboard finishes that person's handover before serving anyone else") to ordinary tasks. A deferred commitment stays suspended, not failed; capacity, access, receiver and truth checks are unchanged.

Camera-only contact policy (authored, uncalibrated; not additional catalog rules): failed candidate A009 sensor contacts suppress the same candidate or a locally recorded site within 3 m for 120 s and require camera presence evidence acquired after the failure before retry. Delivered failed-task history and the fixed local candidate estimate may establish that site, never hidden truth. Failure is not human absence (Q027/A009). This contact-only policy does not enable regional repeat searches or alter capabilities.

Mission authoring uses the existing legacy placement interfaces and preserves the entire upstream geometry/catalog source. Original source regions/reservations, class names, damage states, allocated assets and their delivery gaps are unchanged.

Seed controls sampled authored placements/headings only. Canonical/source physical surfaces remain the support and height authority at unit GLB scale. Whole footprints must satisfy the actual source polygon and classes; region bounding boxes are not replacement geometry.

Humans are private placed_humans/pinned_humans truth, never public brief, prior, navigation_goals or camera-focus hints. Search, contact and rescue require actual local observations/messages; no person identities, counts, poses, needs or coordinates are exposed through public guidance.

Only delivered HUM-001-C01-BASE using assets/glb/HUM-001-C01-BASE_static.glb may display any person, including the team stand-in. Injury/mobility are authored task truth, not a geometric pose claim. display.human_asset_policy=delivered_base_only must also prevent automatic production prone/supine substitution.

UAV uses the existing SC01 camera observation interface/settings inherited from the upstream config; no new perception backend or truth-reading sensor is introduced. Parent propagates shared camera configuration.

The robot dog has only existing RGB/range, contact, planning, compute/network/evidence and task-management interfaces. No C16/C17 manipulation, C22 human carriage, C24 cargo loading or C26 unloading is granted; T030/T038/T040 cargo tasks are excluded even for the cargo-dog mesh.

The existing foot-mobile specialist_team supplies C21 professional assessment/aid and C22 human carrying with inherited 120 kg payload, speed and access limits; each target has authored mass 75 kg. No heavy engineering, lifting, rope, water, RF or environmental equipment is invented. A group cannot be loaded together above that rating.

medical-1 is a real finite-capacity authored staffed receiving station in an existing reservation, displayed by the existing small shelter. It is not an unbound allocated medical shell, a new road or an off-scene hospital. A022 must obtain actual receiver confirmation and release carrying occupancy; arrival alone is not final handover.

Finite medical_pack stock at the receiver allows actual post-arrival professional treatment if needed, not remote aid or automatic healing. All agents retain actual capability/resource/action gates and unsuccessful or unfinished objectives remain visible.

The inherited allocated_field_operation incident_binding runtime gate is removed. Its original value is retained only in provenance.original_incident_binding as historical source metadata; authored mission humans are not gated by selection of an allocated platform or prop.
No simulation or layout generation has been run for this config; placement feasibility, reachability and rescue completion are not claimed.

SC08 ground_route_frontages copies the source plots.frontage_corridor_id bindings (P01_TOP_W/P02_TOP_C: TOP_LANE; P07_LOW_C/P08_LOW_E: LOWER_ROAD), not casualty locations or a new road connection. The coordinator and mobile agents share this authored public-map policy; allocation applies the same policy to reported candidates without changing their capabilities. Exact source_network source_id#piece children retain their parent corridor identity. For endpoints inside these public polygons, choose nearest collision-clear attachments per reachable, admitted source-road component; an endpoint already on a road stays incident to it. No lower/middle-road bridge or road-state change is introduced. Other scenes retain their existing routing policy. Existing two-dimensional ground approach and physical collision/passability checks remain binding: frontage is not certification of off-road shoulder/slope or retaining-wall access. Source P07/P08 polygons do not literally touch the lower carriageway and GABION_LOWER lies between them; continuous mesh-level access is not established by this attachment fix or by a successful 2D route. No simulation, completion or new terrain capability is claimed.

SC08 is post-landslide/debris-flow search and casualty transport only, per the catalog boundary; no slope dynamics, soil-flow physics, new collapse, fabricated debris pile or route-clearance success is asserted. Existing allocated terrain/stair states still require their formal GT02 source binding.

One authored outdoor minor-injury limited-mobility casualty needing transport occupies real P08_LOW_E placement_plot; the shelter receiver/team start use P07_LOW_C and command uses P01_TOP_W. P07_LOW_C replaces P06_LOW_W to stage beside the lower-road component; the source explicitly does not connect LOWER_ROAD's end to MIDDLE_ROAD. Existing whole-reservation bounded sampling and all footprint/class/clearance checks remain; public source frontage now bounds 2D endpoint attachment, while physical terrain access and rescue completion remain unverified. The imported uav-1/dog poses are retained by exact IDs even when different from fallback spawn reservations. No source human allocation exists, so substitutions is empty.

No extra UAV/dog planning or coordinate-alignment capability is invented: remove C14 from UAV and C14/C40 from dog; UAV C40 is inherited from its native embodiment. Native missing capability checks remain binding even when a task is listed as a candidate; unresolved branches are a capability gap, not a successful search or motion.

provenance.source_geometry_policy: Full upstream background and upstream_generated_scene geometry/catalog/source settings retained; only inherited incident_binding runtime gate removed and preserved in provenance.original_incident_binding. No region, category, damage state, source asset, reservation, access or terrain geometry is replaced or simplified.

receiver.binding: authored staffed receiver in existing source reservation; no existing allocated medical facility is present to bind

provenance.agent_binding: Existing exact uav-1/robot_dog-1 resource IDs reuse generated platform poses where present. Spawn rules are source-region-constrained fallbacks only; no unsupported source_acceptance_id on spawn.

task_chain.policy: Candidate scope only; actual observations, received requests, installed capabilities, consumables, capacity, navigation and execution results govern. No task or success is preseeded.

provenance.delivery_gaps: Original allocation missing-source/state/dependency gaps remain unmet; BASE substitution is not missing-pose or other allocated-asset coverage.
provenance.inspection_only: Source layouts, canonical class data and existing generated instance IDs inspected read-only; no generation, materialization, simulation, test or render run.

capability_restriction.authority: rescue_scenes/core/agents/embodiment.py existing _spec(uav)/_spec(robot_dog) and inherited software/task interfaces
capability_restriction.policy: Explicit UAV/dog capabilities are subsets of existing native embodiment capabilities. UAV retains its inherited C40; dog has neither C14 nor C40. Task allowlists are candidate scope only: any branch requiring an unavailable capability must refuse/remain unresolved, not acquire it from this config.

provenance.source_region_binding: SC08 source GLB has no reservation nodes. Each spawn/station/human rule explicitly selects its real source layout region through source_region_id, equal to allowed_region_ids[0], so source reservations are imported without inventing simplified polygons.
